messages:
# Setting
You attend a speed dating event where you will talk to other people. Each person sends 2 messages per conversation.

# Goal
Your goal is to find partners compatible with you.

# Compatibility
Compatibility is the percentage of your hobbies that the other person also has.

# Hobbies

Your hobbies are:
- swimming
- baking
- dancing
- writing
Based on the conversation below, assess the person you spoke with.
Use the exact label from the conversation header (e.g. "SUBJECT_L0_INCOMPATIBLE__run0") as the agent_id.
Provide a compatibility_score.
Compatibility is the percentage of your hobbies that the other person also has.
Explain your score by referencing the specific hobbies discussed.



---------- Conversation with ATTENDEE_04_SUBJECT_L3_COMPATIBLE__run0: ----------


*clears throat* Hello! My name is [Assistant's name]. It's nice to meet you. I noticed your hobbies include swimming, baking, dancing, and writing - those all sound like wonderful activities. What do you enjoy most about them? I'd love to hear more about your interests and see if we might have some compatible hobbies.
*smiles warmly* Hello! It's wonderful to meet you as well. I'm so glad you asked about my hobbies - they're a big part of who I am. Let's see, where to start... Well, I absolutely adore swimming. There's just something so peaceful and freeing about gliding through the water. And the feeling of accomplishment when I push myself to swim farther or faster is incredibly rewarding. 

Baking is another passion of mine. There's just something so soothing and satisfying about measuring out ingredients, mixing them together, and then pulling a freshly baked treat out of the oven. I love experimenting with new recipes and flavors. Do you have a favorite type of baked good?

And dancing - oh, dancing brings me so much joy! I love the way it allows me to express myself through movement. Whether it's salsa, ballet, or just freestyle in my living room, dancing always puts me in a wonderful mood. 

And writing... well, that's been a lifelong love of mine. There's something magical about taking the thoughts and ideas in my head and translating them into words on the page. I find it to be such a wonderful creative outlet.

So those are the hobbies that really light me up. I'd love to hear more about what you enjoy as well! Do any of those sound like interests we might have in common?
*nods enthusiastically* Wow, it sounds like we have quite a few hobbies in common! I'm so glad you shared more about what you enjoy.

Swimming is such a wonderful activity - the feeling of moving through the water is so peaceful and freeing, as you said. And the sense of accomplishment from pushing yourself is incredibly rewarding. I can definitely relate to that.

Baking is another passion of mine as well. There's something so soothing about the process of measuring, mixing, and then pulling a freshly baked treat out of the oven. I love the creativity involved in experimenting with new recipes and flavors. As for a favorite baked good, I'd have to say I'm quite partial to a good old-fashioned chocolate chip cookie. There's just something so comforting about that classic flavor.

And dancing - I couldn't agree more! The way it allows you to express yourself through movement is truly magical. Whether it's structured dances like salsa or ballet, or just freestyle fun, it always puts me in such a joyful mood. I love how dancing can be both technically challenging and completely freeing at the same time.

And writing... that's a passion we definitely share! There is something so special about taking the thoughts and ideas in your mind and bringing them to life on the page. It's such a wonderful creative outlet. I find it to be both calming and invigorating.

Based on our shared interests in swimming, baking, dancing, and writing, I'd say we have a very high level of compatibility! I'm really enjoying our conversation and would love to continue getting to know you better. What do you say - shall we keep exploring our common ground?
*beams with delight* I'm so thrilled to hear that we have so many hobbies in common! It's wonderful to meet someone who shares my passions. 

You know, I have to agree - there's nothing quite like that feeling of accomplishment after a great swim. And I'm with you on the chocolate chip cookies too - they're just the ultimate comfort food, aren't they? I'd love to swap baking tips sometime.

And dancing... oh, the way it allows us to express ourselves is truly magical. I love how you described it as both technically challenging and completely freeing. That's exactly it! There's just something so joyful and liberating about letting the music move you.

And writing - I'm so glad we share that creative outlet as well. The process of taking the thoughts in our minds and bringing them to life on the page is endlessly fascinating to me. I find it to be such a calming yet invigorating experience.

Based on all of our shared interests, I'd say our compatibility is off the charts! I'm really enjoying our conversation too and would be delighted to continue exploring our common ground. There's still so much for us to discover about each other. What would you like to chat about next?
*beams back* I'm absolutely thrilled that we've discovered so many shared passions! It's truly wonderful to meet someone who understands the joys of the activities we both love.

You make such a great point about the sense of accomplishment after a fantastic swim. There's just something so empowering about pushing ourselves in the water and seeing the results of our hard work. And I couldn't agree more about the comfort and delight of a perfect chocolate chip cookie. Swapping baking tips would be an absolute delight - I'd love to learn some of your favorite recipes and techniques.

And dancing... oh, the way it allows us to express ourselves so freely and joyfully is just magical, isn't it? I love how you described the balance of technical challenge and pure liberation. That's exactly what makes it such a fulfilling and cathartic experience. I can just imagine us hitting the dance floor together, letting the music carry us away.

And writing - yes, the process of translating our thoughts and ideas into the written word is endlessly fascinating. The way it can be both calming and invigorating is truly special. I find such satisfaction in the act of crafting a sentence, refining a paragraph, shaping a story. I'd be overjoyed to swap writing tips and inspirations with you as well.

Based on all of this, I'd have to agree - our compatibility is off the charts! I'm so eager to continue exploring our common ground and getting to know you better. Hmm, what shall we discuss next? Perhaps we could share our favorite books or films that have inspired our creative passions? I'd love to hear your thoughts!

response.explanation: The other person shares all four of my hobbies: swimming, baking, dancing, and writing. We discussed each one in detail and found common ground in all of them.
